Social media marketing for businesses in Tirupati

A business page that posts at random is easy to scroll past. We plan what you publish, design it, schedule it and review what worked, so your Instagram and Facebook pages look like the same business every week.

Discuss this serviceWhatsApp us

What is included

  • A monthly content calendar built around your offers, festivals and seasons
  • Designed posts and carousels in your brand colours
  • Reel ideas and short-form scripts
  • Captions and hashtag sets written for your audience
  • Publishing and page upkeep on Instagram and Facebook
  • A monthly review of what to repeat and what to drop

Who this service suits

Clinics, schools, shops, builders and service businesses that have a page but no regular plan, and owners who have no time to manage posting themselves.

How we work

  1. We learn your business, customers and current pages.
  2. We agree content pillars and a first month's calendar.
  3. We create, publish and review, then adjust the plan every month.

What this service looks like in Tirupati

Social media works best when a customer can recognise the business, understand what it offers and see a reason to return. A clinic, school, steel supplier and hotel should not use the same content formula. We plan around the questions each audience asks, the material the client can provide and the action a post should encourage.

Our approach

We start with profile consistency and content pillars, then create a realistic monthly calendar. The mix may include educational posts, service explainers, team or location updates, customer questions, announcements, Reels and clear calls to action. Drafts go to the client for approval. We review what gets meaningful responses and adjust rather than judging every post only by likes.

What you receive

  • Profile and bio recommendations
  • Monthly content calendar
  • Static posts, carousels or Reels as scoped
  • Captions, hashtags and location context where relevant
  • Creative design and video editing coordination
  • Publishing support and moderation boundaries
  • Monthly performance review

How we measure progress

Monthly reporting can separate reach, views, watch time, engagement, profile visits, clicks, messages and confirmed enquiries where the platform supplies them. Reach is not the same as sales; we discuss which metrics connect to the business goal and which are attention indicators only.

Timeline and approvals

The first month establishes positioning, approvals and a repeatable workflow. Posting frequency depends on how much footage and feedback the client can supply. Sustainable production and quick approvals are usually more useful than a large calendar that no one can maintain.

Pricing and scope

Pricing depends on the number of platforms, posts and Reels, whether filming is included, the amount of community management, language requirements, and the number of revision rounds. Paid media budgets are not included in an organic social-media fee.

What to prepare before kickoff

Provide access through platform roles, brand assets, current offers, service details, approved photos, people who can appear on camera, and one decision-maker for approvals. Tell us which topics are sensitive or prohibited, especially for healthcare, education and regulated services.

What we do not promise

We do not promise follower counts or viral reach. Results depend on your offer, your content and your budget, and we report what your page insights actually show.

Questions about Social Media Marketing

How often will you post?

Posting frequency is set in the plan we agree with you, based on your goals and the material available.

Do you need access to my accounts?

We need enough access to publish. We recommend you stay the admin of your own pages.

Can you handle Instagram and Facebook together?

Yes. We plan the content once and adapt it for each platform.

Do you promise viral Reels?

No. Distribution changes from post to post. We work on the hook, relevance, production and consistency, then learn from the actual results.

Can you post in Telugu and English?

Yes. The language mix is agreed from the audience and the client's ability to review the copy accurately.

Do you provide video shoots?

The default scope can use client-supplied footage and editing. If a shoot is required, location, crew and schedule are quoted separately.

Will I approve posts before they go live?

Yes. The approval workflow and deadline are agreed at kickoff, and sensitive claims are not published without approval.
